## Adoption rule (agreed in advance)
GNN is adopted only if it beats both the MLP and the rule on AP and RC@1 on the held-out synthetic protocols by more than the seed spread.

```
family ap   gnn 0.329 vs mlp  0.522: diff -0.193, needs > 0.021  -> does NOT beat
family ap   gnn 0.329 vs rule 0.227: diff +0.102, needs > 0.021  -> beats
family rc1  gnn 0.481 vs mlp  0.637: diff -0.156, needs > 0.020  -> does NOT beat
family rc1  gnn 0.481 vs rule 0.461: diff +0.020, needs > 0.020  -> beats
size   ap   gnn 0.160 vs mlp  0.415: diff -0.255, needs > 0.018  -> does NOT beat
size   ap   gnn 0.160 vs rule 0.144: diff +0.016, needs > 0.010  -> beats
size   rc1  gnn 0.437 vs mlp  0.557: diff -0.120, needs > 0.011  -> does NOT beat
size   rc1  gnn 0.437 vs rule 0.354: diff +0.082, needs > 0.011  -> beats
```

**Verdict: GNN NOT adopted.**
